title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Affiche Fluo for your AI sport and nutrition coach. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Affiche Fluo
options.lineage: French club gala and tournament posters on dayglo paper
options.thesis: Your programme printed like the poster for your own gala: loud paper, black ink, you on the bill.
options.viewport: Left rail (Aujourd'hui, Programme, Nutrition, Coach, Profil) in black; the day's session fills a yellow sheet as a billed card of exercises; breakfast sits beside it on pink stock; the coach's adjustments on green.
options.risk: Four fluo stocks can shout over the data if every panel is coloured at once.

raised.raise: One niveau slider re-sets every load and rep count on the sheet live, not exercise by exercise.
Each paper colour means one thing everywhere: yellow training, pink nutrition, orange cardio, green coach.
Weeks compare on one fixed scale, so progress is read by eye, never by relabelled axes.
Nothing is labelled twice: the stock colour replaces the section title wherever it can.

options.label: Feuille de Match
options.lineage: Federation match sheets in carbonless triplicate
options.thesis: The programme as the official sheet of your own match: every box filled, signed by the coach.
options.viewport: Top bar with the user's licence-style profile strip; the session as a ruled roster table of exercises; nutrition as the pink copy beneath.
options.risk: Quiet and administrative; closest to what a tidy fitness dashboard already looks like.

options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.thesis: The week as lines: training, cardio and meals run in parallel and interchange where one changes another.
options.viewport: Top bar; a week diagram of three coloured lines across the screen with today's station open below as the session and breakfast detail.
options.case: Shows the linked-plan mechanism better than any other card; athletes identify with it less than with their own club's poster.
options.risk: A dark diagram leading the screen can push the actual exercises below the fold.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.thesis: Soft cards on a warm ground, and the one bright colour is always something you can press.
options.viewport: Single column of cards: today's session, breakfast, coach note; bottom bar with five tabs.
options.case: Clearest for a first-time beginner; says nothing about sport and could be any wellness app.
options.risk: Pleasant and forgettable; indistinguishable from a meditation or budgeting app.

options.label: Variable Type Specimen
options.thesis: One slider morphs the whole grid.
options.viewport: A giant figure with sliders beneath.
options.case: A type foundry's world; athletes do not see themselves in it and exercises are not glyphs.
options.kept: One control that remaps everything continuously.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: Terrain is fixed colour; the course rides over it in purple.
options.viewport: A map window around the current leg.
options.case: Belongs to one niche sport outside the seven listed; a map adds nothing to a strength session.
options.kept: A colour legend whose meanings never move.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: Five plates on one stem at one scale.
options.viewport: Five aligned plates across the screen.
options.case: Slow, contemplative and bookish where the product must feel like training.
options.kept: Stages compared at one fixed scale.
options.risk: Reads as a herbal tea brand.

options.label: Factory Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Everything is a numbered entry; colour blocks stand in for words.
options.viewport: A black field with one plot and a number.
options.case: Hides labels by design, which contradicts a product whose promise is to explain every choice.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The dark fitness app: black ground, one neon accent, progress rings and rounded cards.
canonCard.viewport: Greeting, three ring stats, today's workout card, meal card, bottom tab bar.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
